fieldValues.title: The process says what it could not establish
fieldValues.summary: With no attendee list and no speaker labels the run marked nobody present and asked who was there; seven of eleven tasks say owner not named; it raised 32 open questions, including whether the spending fitted the group's per-job limit.
evidence: Meeting A first trial: 7 attendance records, all mentioned; open question "Who was actually at the meeting?"
Meeting A final run: open questions from every stage; task who fields
fieldValues.body: Guidance in the package (never guess a name, a date, an owner or a decision) and a place to put doubt were enough. The same question is asked by several stages: nothing stops repeats.
